This [[Sith (species)/Legends|Pureblood]] [[Sith/Legends|Sith]] was a member of the [[Lost Tribe of Sith]] on [[Kesh/Legends|Kesh]] in [[4985 BBY]], serving as a sentry. During the [[Red Sith Purge|purge]] of Pureblood Sith from Kesh that year, the sentry was trapped and [[Death/Legends|killed]], never abandoning his post.
